title: Palantir Technologies
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Palantir is the enterprise AI agent deployment platform for organisations that cannot put their data in a hyperscaler's training pipeline. Defence agencies, intelligence services, and regulated enterprises need AI decision-making on their proprietary, classified, or compliance-sensitive data. Palantir AIP provides exactly this: and the switching costs once a defence customer integrates Palantir into operational decision workflows are enormous. Revenue growth is accelerating, driven by AIP commercial adoption adding to the stable government contract base. The market has historically underestimated how durable Palantir's government revenue is and how large the commercial AIP opportunity is.

Future Tech Roadmap

AI Software Engineering Agent Confident Ongoing
AI that autonomously writes, tests, and deploys production software
📈 Palantir AIP (AI Platform) enables enterprise organisations to deploy AI agents that operate on their proprietary data within security boundaries. AIP revenue is growing faster than Palantir's traditional Foundry/Gotham products. This is the commercial AI agent product with the deepest defence and intelligence customer base.
⚡ 2ND · 70% behind MSFT 90% (−20pp)
Autonomous AI Agent Confident 2025
AI that plans, uses tools, and executes multi-step tasks with minimal human input
📈 Palantir AIP is the leading enterprise platform for autonomous AI decision-making in defence, intelligence, and commercial operations. The combination of proprietary operational data and AI agent execution is the Palantir moat: it is very difficult to replicate the customer relationships and data integrations.
⚡ 2ND · 70% behind MSFT 75% (−5pp)
AI-Driven Threat Detection Confident 2026
ML models detecting novel attacks, zero-days, and insider threats in real time
📈 Palantir Gotham and Metropolis apply AI to intelligence analysis, threat detection, and operational decision support at government scale. This is the original Palantir business: now augmented by LLM-based analysis through AIP. Long-term government contracts provide revenue stability.
⚡ 2ND · 60% behind CRWD 85% (−25pp)
⚡ 2ND · 70% behind MSFT 90% (−20pp)

Business & Fundamental Analysis

Financial Health & Profitability

Yes, profitable and expanding. Palantir is highly profitable, achieving continuous GAAP net income profitability. It maintains gross margins above 80% with zero debt.

AI Monetization & Business Goals

Palantir's core goal is to dominate enterprise AI deployment through its Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP). AIP enables corporations to integrate LLMs with their internal operational databases.

  • Commercial Acceleration: Driving 40%+ YoY growth in US commercial customer counts.
  • Government Dominance: Securing multi-year defense and intelligence contracts (e.g. Maven project).

Capital Expenditure (Capex) Concerns

Palantir is a pure software provider. It has virtually no physical datacenter capital requirements, relying instead on cloud partnerships (AWS, Microsoft Azure) for scaling.

Partnerships & Alliances

  • Microsoft: Expanding Azure cloud hosting and government-isolated integrations for Palantir AIP.
  • Oracle: Multi-cloud hosting partnership to deliver AIP across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

Controversies & Headwinds

  • Valuation Multiple Premium: Trading at an extremely elevated trailing P/E multiple (~80-100x), leaving no margin for earnings growth deceleration.\n
